svg.text: AI Application Security & Data Protection Controls
Day N: Sentinel policy engine | Kavach customer approval | Tool gates | LLM boundary | Hash-linked audit | Release gate and kill switches
Day 1: Secrets in Secret Manager | Dedicated build service account | Automatic Cloud SQL backup before each release | Cloud Logging and Monitoring | Scheduled database start and stop
Day 0: Trusted infrastructure (Titan) | Default encryption at rest | Encrypted service-to-service communication | Admin audit logs
Kosh: secure agentic banking on Google Cloud. Mitra proposes, Sentinel decides, the customer approves with Kavach.
Only deployed components are shown. Region: us-central1 (Gemini on the global Vertex AI endpoint).
